description: This file defines the Localizable interface for handling localizable strings within the Apache Commons Math3 library, specifically in the exception utility package.

classes.name: Localizable
classes.description: An interface for objects that can provide source (non-localized) and localized strings based on locale.

methods.name: getLocalizedString
methods.description: Returns the localized string for the given locale or the source string if no localization is available.
